GEOTHERMAL_GRADIENT.description: Controls temperature-depth profile for vein formation
GEOTHERMAL_GRADIENT.rationale: Continental crust typically 20-35°C/km, extended range to 40 for sensitivity testing

VEIN_SALINITY_THRESHOLD.description: Salinity threshold for high-temperature vein formation
VEIN_SALINITY_THRESHOLD.rationale: Fluid inclusion data from Zambian Copperbelt (Selley et al. 2005) suggests 28-35 wt% range

INITIAL_COPPER_PPM.description: Initial dissolved copper concentration in basinal brine
INITIAL_COPPER_PPM.rationale: Basinal brines typically carry 50-300 ppm Cu, focused on lower-mid range for sediment-hosted deposits

BRINE_OXIDATION.description: Oxidation state of brine (must be >0.5 for Cu transport)
BRINE_OXIDATION.rationale: Explores near-threshold behavior; 0.5 is critical transition for copper solubility

PRECIP_EFFICIENCY.description: Fraction of dissolved copper that precipitates at redox boundaries
PRECIP_EFFICIENCY.rationale: Kinetic and chemical reaction efficiency uncertainty (0.5-0.9 represents realistic range)
